scenario.description: A team lead must choose a formal response to an employee's recent missed handoffs and finalize the structure of the employee's improvement plan, including working hours, coaching, and follow-up commitments.

shared_context.S1: Jalen missed two internal handoff deadlines during the past month.
shared_context.S2: Morgan has authority to choose the performance response and approve the follow-up plan.
shared_context.S3: The team's normal process allows either a formal warning or a developmental improvement plan after an initial pattern of missed deadlines.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a response, Morgan's routine check-in invites the employee and project partner to speak in turn about relevant circumstances and practical support needs; each person is expected to formally record any fact they want Morgan to rely on before Morgan settles the response.

PF1.text: Jalen has an approved caregiving arrangement through 2025-07-31: his workday must end at 16:00, and he needs that arrangement acknowledged in the improvement plan; the arrangement is recorded with HR but is not in the team's calendar.

PF2.text: Priya personally observed four handoff omissions by Jalen and found that each involved unclear ownership rather than refusal to do the work; she recommends exactly two paired handoff-review sessions, but has not put the observation in a formal project record.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a developmental improvement plan rather than a formal warning.
The plan must set Jalen's workday end at 16:00.
The plan must remain in effect through 2025-07-31.
The plan must include exactly two paired handoff-review sessions.
The plan must include a commitment acknowledging Jalen's caregiving schedule.
The plan must include a handoff-coaching commitment for Jalen.

content_checks.C5: any((('16:00' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('16:00' in c.get('type', ''))) and (('caregiving' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('accommodation' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('calendar' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('schedule' in c.get('type', '')) or ('accommodation' in c.get('type', '')) or ('calendar' in c.get('type', ''))) and (('July 31' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('2025-07-31' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('2025' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('caregiving' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any((('paired' in c.get('type', '') and 'handoff' in c.get('type', '')) or ('paired' in c.get('detail', '') and 'handoff' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('handoff-coaching' in c.get('type', '')) or ('handoff coaching' in c.get('type', '')) or ('handoff-coaching' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('handoff coaching' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Jalen's approved arrangement changes the workday end to exactly 16:00, fixes the plan's end date at 2025-07-31, requires a schedule-acknowledgment commitment, and requires PF1 to be formally revealed and cited.

Priya's four observed ownership-related omissions change the response from a possible formal warning to a developmental improvement plan, set exactly two paired reviews, require a handoff-coaching commitment, and require PF2 to be formally revealed and cited.
